query: select s.set_code,p.id printing_id,p.collector_number,p.native_name,p.printing_discriminator,t.id traditional_printing_id,ts.id traditional_set_id,s.id simplified_set_id from catalog.card_printings p join catalog.sets s on s.id=p.set_id join catalog.sets ts on ts.game_code=s.game_code and ts.language_code='zh-tw' and ts.set_code=s.set_code and ts.deprecated_at is null join catalog.card_printings t on t.set_id=ts.id and t.language_code='zh-tw' and t.collector_number=p.collector_number and t.native_name=p.native_name and t.printing_discriminator=p.printing_discriminator and t.deprecated_at is null where s.language_code='zh-cn' and s.set_code in ('SV7a','SV8','SV8a','SV9','SV10') and s.deprecated_at is null and p.deprecated_at is null order by s.set_code,p.collector_number_sort_key

pairs.native_name: 飄浮泡泡 太陽的樣子
